## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 to production (unhealthy in all regions, error rate 0.18).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Checked service status and deployment history. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — The first attempt to create the incident timed out, and verification showed no incident was created, so I retried with an idempotency key. Incident **INC-0002** is now open and the on-call engineer has been paged, describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy: true**, error rate 0.002.
